hook.text: A restaurant has a huge line outside. You join it—even though you've never heard of the place.

buildup.text: The bandwagon effect: we adopt beliefs and behaviors because many other people do the same.

discovery.text: Asch's conformity experiments showed people denied what their own eyes saw just to match the group.

twist.text: Markets bubble and crash partly on bandwagon momentum—everyone buys because everyone else is buying.

climax.text: Popular doesn't mean correct. The crowd can be wise, but it can also be collectively delusional.

quiz.question: What does the bandwagon effect describe?
options: Adopting behaviors because many others do
